technique_name: Identify the key differences between a butterfly and a moth.
description: The key differences between butterflies and moths are primarily in their anatomy, behavior, and life cycles. Butterflies have larger wings that have brightly-colored patterns and typically fly during the day. In contrast, moths tend to be nocturnal and have dull colors and feathery patterns on their wings.
